notes.title: Beholder: Conductor — Release Date Reveal
notes.notes:
Beholder: Conductor will be leaving the station and launching April 23rd on Steam. In this spin-off in the Beholder series, you step into the role of a senior conductor on the legendary Determination Bringer train, tasked with monitoring passengers, enforcing strict regulations, and completing high-stakes Ministry assignments that could determine their future. 

[previewyoutube=xwIS1SPvQoA;full][/previewyoutube]
The train is preparing for a long and thrilling journey across the country. 
Your responsibilities include readying the compartments, welcoming the passengers, and enforcing order throughout the route. You will meet people from all corners of the nation. Hear their stories. And decide — who deserves to ride on, and who will be removed from the train.  

As your loyalty to the Ministry deepens, you will unlock access to secret missions that offer rewards and opportunities for promotion. But beware – the journey is filled with risks, including encounters with smugglers, bribery, and corruption. Your choices will shape the lives of passengers — and the course of history, leading to multiple endings. 

[b]Please review and comply with the Ministry’s directives: [/b]

[list]
[*] Monitor all passengers 
[*] Report their actions and file misconduct notices 
[*] Conduct baggage searches (preferably unnoticed) 
[*] Rise through the ranks… or come under investigation 
[/list]
Ticket price will be disclosed on departure day. New conductors will receive 10% off during the first 10 days after launch 

The Ministry relies on your loyalty:

notes.title: Beholder 2 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Today, the Ministry of Updates wishes to report on the progress made over the last several days.[/b]

[b]Ministry of Innovations:[/b]
Added controller vibration at key gameplay moments.

[b]Ministry of Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed an issue where two visitors could come to Evan's workplace on the first floor at the same time, causing the game to crash. 

[b]Ministry of Collateral Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified controller map;
[*] Optimized animations;
[*] Fixed graphical issues.
[/list]
[b]
Glory to the Wise Leader![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506429/f7d030c05b66555a5a8041a17b66119947eb209e.png[/img]

notes.title: Beholder 2 Update
notes.notes:
The Minister of Updates wishes to report on the successful work session at the recent meeting of the Cabinet of Ministers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506429/f7d030c05b66555a5a8041a17b66119947eb209e.png[/img]

[b]Ministry of Innovations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to open Biometric Safes one by one.
[*] Added the ability to view the full texts of appeals in the Floor 12 minigame.
[*] Added the ability to remap the key to make Evan walk when using the keyboard.
[/list]

[b]Ministry of Game Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made the quest "Win or Die!" easier to complete.
[*] Reduced the time taken to process forms in the Floor 12 minigame.
[*] Reduced the minimal number of forms for the Floor 12 minigame.
[*] Increased the reward for meeting the requirements of the Floor 12 minigame.
[*] Changed the requirements for some clone professions in the Floor 25 minigame.
[*] Added new professions for clones in the Floor 25 minigame.
[/list]

[b]Ministry of Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could block the quest “The Escape”.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Pause menu and Game menu buttons to work incorrectly on gamepads (PS4/Xbox).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the instructions for the Floor 12 minigame to be duplicated.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the main theme music to be mistakenly played when loading a save during the event in the 1st-floor Boss’s office.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause Evan to fall through the textures of the 25th floor office.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character could sit in a chair during the arrest.
[*] Fixed a bug during the quest “Past Mistakes” that could lead to the game process being blocked.
[/list]

[b]Ministry of Collateral Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Polish localization.
[*] The intro quote is displayed for longer.
[*] Corrected and added voiceover to some game scenes.
[*] Improved some game scenes.
[*] Changed the order of newly added information in the “Profile” tab.
[*] Changed the order of instructions for the Floor 12 minigame.
[/list]

[b]The Wise Leader is pleased with the work done by the Ministry of Updates. Glory to the Wise Leader!
 
[/b]

notes.title: Beholder 2 Update
notes.notes:
Today the Minister of Updates wishes to report on some recent developments.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506429/f7d030c05b66555a5a8041a17b66119947eb209e.png[/img]

[b]Ministry of Innovations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added German, Korean and Polish localizations.
[*] Added a new type of a save file (“Daily Save”) that automatically saves game progress at the start of each in-game day.
[*] Added a controller icon to the game menu (when PS4/Xbox controller is in use).
[/list]

[b]Ministry of Game Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*]The system for penalizing theft has been improved: 
[olist]
[*]When you steal something, you’ll see an in-game notification.
[*]The first time you’re caught with stolen items, you’ll receive a warning.
[*]The next time you’re caught, you’ll be able to pay the fine later.
[/olist]
[i][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/i] these changes are not applicable if you are caught with items prohibited by the Government.
[*]Increased some bill discounts from reading books.
[*]Increased the rewards for the following quests: “Cover-up”, “The Most Dangerous Game”, “Carl Zero”, “Beneficial Effect”, “Epidemic”, “Past Mistakes”.
[/list]
[b]Ministry of Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to change the screen resolution.
[*] Fixed a bug where graphics settings could not be applied.
[*] Fixed a bug that lead to duplicate Autosave and Quick Save files.
[*] Fixed a quest in which Peter Dong kept offering to help with promotion after promotion was already achieved.
[*] Fixed a bug that lead to loss of control after a conversation with a courier (“Deal with the Devil” quest).
[*] Fixed a bug that led to an incorrect camera position after loading save files.
[*] Fixed a bug that lead to incorrect avatars being shown in dialogues.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to open a file while testing clones in the “Carl Zero” quest.
[*] Fixed a bug where prohibited items turned up in “Lost and Found” after their owners were arrested.
[*] Fixed a bug where a theft warning appeared when you put any of your items into the inventories of other characters.
[*] Fixed a bug where a loaded save file led to old emails in the Patriot Terminal being marked as unread.
[*] Fixed a bug where there were no bills, but the buttons were active in the “BILLS” section.
[*] Fixed a bug that lead to loss of control while completing the “Win or Die!” quest.
[*] Fixed a bug regarding earning the “Mischief Managed” achievement.
[*] Fixed a bug where both the “Film and Tape” and “The Escape” quests were marked completed if a player completed either of them.
[*] Linux. Fixed a bug where the game couldn’t be run in windowed mode.
[/list]

[b]Ministry of Collateral Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Chinese and English localizations.
[*] Improved some animations.
[*] Improved some cut-scenes.
[*] Improved the GUI.
[/list]

[b]Would any of this have been possible without the Wise Leader at the helm of our Great State?
We all know the answer to that![/b]
